name: Sage S2.1 (model card titled Atria Dawn)

lineage.how_derived: the repository card is the card of Atria Dawn, described as built on the 744B-parameter MoE GLM-5.2 foundation model; the repository name is Sage-S2.1 while the card and API model name say Atria Dawn (the card's download table lists separate internlm/Atria-Dawn repos that did not appear in the HF search; only internlm/Atria-Dawn-Preview and variants did). Which of these is the same weight set was not verified.

purpose: The card says it is a new-generation agentic model for research and engineering scenarios that need continuous environment understanding, tool use and multi-step completion, aimed at executable, verifiable and reproducible results across discovery, creation, delivery (reports, presentations) and cybersecurity.

license.name: MIT (card statement; no LICENSE file in the repository)
license.notes: The card's License section says code and weights are released under the MIT License and links a LICENSE file; the repository has none (404, 2026-11-19) and no YAML licence tag, so no licence text was read.

architecture.kind: sparse MoE with MLA and an indexer (config model_type glm_moe_dsa)
architecture.attention: MLA (q_lora 2048, kv_lora 512, 64 heads, hidden 6144) with an indexer (32 heads, top-k 2048)
architecture.why_this_design: Not given; the card describes the application dimensions only. 744B is the card's figure for the GLM-5.2 base; the card gives no active-parameter count.

variants.format: preview release, 256K context per the card
variants.notes: separate repo; not opened beyond the card's download table

pc-12gb.notes: 1.5 TB BF16, no quantised derivative of this repository found (HF API lists 0 derivatives)

pc-32gb.notes: even 1 bit per weight of 744B is about 93 GB for the weights alone, but no quantised file exists and the card gives no active count; not assessed further

engine_support.notes: The card lists local deployment and Codex, Claude Code and Kimi Code harness setups; llama.cpp was not checked.

benchmarks.name: Terminal-Bench 2.1
benchmarks.variant: Atria Dawn (Opus 5 90.2, GLM 5.3 86.0, DeepSeek V4 Pro 0813 77.0)

benchmarks.name: AutomationBench
benchmarks.variant: Atria Dawn, best in its row

benchmarks.name: BFCL V4
benchmarks.variant: Atria Dawn, best in its row

strengths: Vendor: best of the compared models on AutomationBench, CyberGym, SkillsBench, WideSearch, BFCL V4 and DeepSearchQA
weaknesses: DeepSWE 49.3 is far below peers in the same table (GLM 5.3 67.3)
soft.maturity: Shanghai AI Laboratory; the repository naming (Sage-S2.1 with an Atria Dawn card) is inconsistent and the release line also has Preview variants.

tona_fit.reason: A 744B-class model at 1.5 TB with no quantised release, and the weaker DeepSWE score in its own table; the usable member of the family for our users is the 320B Flash (sage-s2.1-flash, also rejected for the reasons recorded there).

sources.note: README (card of Atria Dawn) with benchmark table and download table, config.json, file size via the HF API; LICENSE 404
HF search: Atria-Dawn-Preview and variants exist; no internlm/Atria-Dawn

open_questions: Whether Sage-S2.1 and the card's Atria Dawn are the same weights, and how Atria Dawn relates to the Sage S2.1 Flash line
